_comment: Theorycraft config for the D4 sustained boss-DPS engine (v15). Every entry cites its source, season, and access date. Override individual entries via data/damage-config.local.json (deep-merged at engine-call time per D4).

_sources.maxroll_damage_s9: Maxroll In-Depth Damage Guide, Season 9 (June 29, 2025). Not yet updated for Season 13. URL: https://maxroll.gg/d4/resources/damage-explained. Accessed: 2026-05-08.
_sources.maxroll_as_s11: Maxroll Attack Speed Mechanics, Season 11 (January 7, 2026). Breakpoint tables do not yet include Paladin/Warlock. URL: https://maxroll.gg/d4/resources/attack-speed-explained. Accessed: 2026-05-08.
_sources.rob2628_s13: Rob2628 Season 13 Cheat Sheet on D4Builds.gg. Accessed: 2026-05-08.
_sources.mekuna_s13: Mekuna Season 13 guides on Mobalytics (Paladin, Warlock, Sorcerer). Accessed: 2026-05-08.
_sources.community_general: Community general knowledge, widely cited, multiple sources.

attributeToBucket._comment: Maps eAttribute names (from datamine) to engine buckets. 'conditional' field drives uptime weighting under boss-DPS framing. Position A (D9, Maxroll S9): Core Skill Damage and Skill-Specific Damage share the same additive bucket.

Attr_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: General skill damage bonus — applies to all skills. Also used as skill scaling coefficient in Power files (base damage coeff per D5).

Attr_Core_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Position A (D9): Core Skill Damage in same additive bucket as other skill damage. Position B alternative: set bucket to 'skill_specific_mult' (distinct multiplicative) via local override.

Attr_Basic_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Basic Skill damage bonus — additive bucket (Position A).

Attr_Defensive_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Defensive Skill damage bonus — additive bucket.

Attr_Ultimate_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Ultimate Skill damage bonus — additive bucket.

Attr_Weapon_Mastery_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Weapon Mastery Skill damage (Barbarian) — additive bucket.

Attr_Pyromancy_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Pyromancy (Sorcerer Fire) skill damage — additive bucket.

Attr_Shock_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Shock (Sorcerer Lightning) skill damage — additive bucket.

Attr_Frost_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Frost (Sorcerer Cold) skill damage — additive bucket.

Attr_Close_Damage_Percent_Bonus.notes: Damage to Close enemies. Applied if class default distance is 'close' (D12).

Attr_Distant_Damage_Percent_Bonus.notes: Damage to Distant enemies. Applied if class default distance is 'distant' (D12).

Attr_Damage_Percent_Bonus_With_Crowd_Con.notes: Damage to CC'd enemies. Zeroed under boss-DPS framing (boss immune to CC, D15).

Attr_Vs_Slowed_Chilled_Percent.notes: Damage to Slowed/Chilled enemies. Zeroed under boss-DPS framing.

Attr_Vs_Stunned_Percent.notes: Damage to Stunned enemies. Zeroed under boss-DPS framing.

Attr_Vs_Frozen_Percent.notes: Damage to Frozen enemies. Zeroed under boss-DPS framing.

Attr_Vs_Burning_Percent.notes: Damage to Burning enemies. While bosses can burn, treated as CC-conditional and zeroed for safe conservative estimate.

Attr_Vs_Poisoned_Percent.notes: Damage to Poisoned enemies. Zeroed under boss-DPS framing.

Attr_Elite_Damage_Percent_Bonus.notes: Damage to Elites — full uptime vs boss (boss is an elite). conditional:elite maps to uptime 1.0.

Attr_Damage_Percent_Bonus_To_Elites.notes: Damage to Elites — full uptime vs boss.

Attr_Vuln_Damage_Percent.notes: Vulnerable Damage bonus. Baseline ×1.20 (Season 9, D13). Uptime 0.90 (D10). Verify for Season 13.

Attr_Vulnerable_Damage_Percent.notes: Vulnerable Damage bonus (alt attribute name). Same treatment as Attr_Vuln_Damage_Percent.

Attr_Crit_Strike_Chance_Percent.notes: Critical Strike Chance. Hard cap 100%. Used in EV formula: critMult = 1 + CSC × CSD (D11).

Attr_Crit_Chance_Percent.notes: Critical Strike Chance (alt attribute name). Same treatment as Attr_Crit_Strike_Chance_Percent.

Attr_Crit_Damage_Percent.notes: Critical Strike Damage bonus. Base 50% CSD (constants.csBaseline). Used in EV formula.

Attr_Crit_Strike_Damage_Percent.notes: Critical Strike Damage bonus (alt attribute name). Same treatment as Attr_Crit_Damage_Percent.

Attr_Attacks_Per_Second_Percent_Bonus.notes: Attack Speed bonus (additive with other AS affixes before breakpoint lookup).

Attr_Attacks_Per_Second_Item_Percent.notes: Attack Speed bonus from item (treated same as Attr_Attacks_Per_Second_Percent_Bonus).

Attr_Cooldown_Reduction_Percent.notes: Cooldown Reduction. Hyperbolic formula: Effective CDR = CDR/(CDR+1.0) (D14, Position A). Reduces cooldown for cooldown-gated skills.

Attr_Strength_Item.notes: Strength stat from items. Primary stat for Barbarian and Paladin. +0.1% damage per point (D33).

Attr_Intelligence_Item.notes: Intelligence stat from items. Primary stat for Sorcerer, Necromancer, and Warlock.

Attr_Willpower_Item.notes: Willpower stat from items. Primary stat for Druid and Spiritborn.

Attr_Dexterity_Item.notes: Dexterity stat from items. Primary stat for Rogue.

Attr_All_Stats.notes: All Stats affix — contributes to the class's primary stat. Engine adds full value to primary stat pool.

Attr_Max_Life.notes: Maximum Life — no DPS contribution. v1 does not model survivability.

Attr_Life_Percent_Bonus.notes: Maximum Life % bonus — no DPS contribution.

Attr_Lucky_Hit_Chance_Percent.notes: Lucky Hit Chance — no DPS contribution in v1 (proc chains excluded per brief).

Attr_Movement_Speed_Bonus_Pct.notes: Movement Speed — no DPS contribution (D31, MS excluded from v1 engine).

Attr_Resource_Cost_Reduction_Percent.notes: Resource Cost Reduction — no direct DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Life_On_Kill.notes: Life on Kill — no DPS contribution.

Attr_Life_On_Hit.notes: Life on Hit — no DPS contribution.

Attr_Thorns.notes: Thorns damage — not counted in sustained boss DPS (requires enemies to hit you).

Attr_Overpower_Damage_Percent.notes: Overpower Damage — excluded from v1 engine (D24). OP requires Life+Fortify state not on schema.

attributeToBucket._comment_v17: v17 entries added 2026-05-10 for expanded affix/aspect catalog (D8 of v17 commission).

Attr_Damage_Percent_Bonus.notes: Generic Damage % bonus — applies to all damage dealt. Additive bucket alongside skill-category damage bonuses.

Attr_Physical_Damage_Percent.notes: Physical Damage % bonus — additive with other elemental/skill damage bonuses.

Attr_Fire_Damage_Percent.notes: Fire Damage % bonus — additive bucket (elemental damage type).

Attr_Cold_Damage_Percent.notes: Cold Damage % bonus — additive bucket (elemental damage type).

Attr_Lightning_Damage_Percent.notes: Lightning Damage % bonus — additive bucket (elemental damage type).

Attr_Shadow_Damage_Percent.notes: Shadow Damage % bonus — additive bucket (elemental damage type).

Attr_Poison_Damage_Percent.notes: Poison Damage % bonus — additive bucket. Poison is a damage-over-time type; treated as elemental-equivalent in v1 engine.

Attr_Bleeding_Damage_Percent.notes: Bleeding Damage % bonus — additive bucket. Bleeding is a damage-over-time type; treated as elemental-equivalent in v1 engine.

Attr_Holy_Damage_Percent.notes: Holy Damage % bonus (Paladin) — additive bucket (elemental damage type for Paladin builds).

Attr_Non_Physical_Damage_Percent.notes: Non-Physical Damage % bonus — additive bucket. Applies when attack does not deal Physical damage.

Attr_Nature_Magic_Damage_Percent.notes: Nature Magic Damage % bonus (Druid) — additive bucket (Storm and Earth skill damage type).

Attr_Weapon_Damage_Percent.notes: Weapon Damage % bonus — additive bucket. Scales base weapon damage contribution.

Attr_Weapon_Damage_Per_Second.notes: Weapon Damage Per Second — additive bucket. This is the flat weapon DPS stat (not a % bonus). Engine treats as additive for affix comparison purposes.

Attr_Berserk_Damage_Percent.notes: Damage while Berserk (Barbarian) — approximated as unconditional for optimised Barbarian builds where Berserk uptime approaches 100%. Conservative builds should override to 'cc' (0 uptime) via data/damage-config.local.json.

Attr_Minion_Damage_Percent.notes: Minion Damage % bonus (general, primarily Necromancer) — additive bucket. Applies to all minion/summon damage types.

Attr_Golem_Damage_Percent.notes: Golem Damage % bonus (Necromancer) — additive bucket (subset of minion damage).

Attr_Skeleton_Damage_Percent.notes: Skeleton Damage % bonus (Necromancer) — additive bucket (subset of minion damage).

Attr_Blood_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Blood Skill Damage % (Necromancer Blood skill category) — additive bucket.

Attr_Affliction_Damage_Percent.notes: Affliction Skill Damage % (Warlock Affliction skill category) — additive bucket.

Attr_Agility_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Agility Skill Damage % (Rogue Agility skill category) — additive bucket.

Attr_Trap_Skill_Damage_Percent.notes: Trap Skill Damage % (Rogue trap-type skills) — additive bucket.

Attr_Stagger_Damage_Percent.notes: Damage to Staggered enemies — treated as cc-conditional (uptime 0.0 under boss-DPS framing). Bosses do have stagger phases, but duration is episodic and not modeled in v1.

Attr_Fury_Regen_Per_Second.notes: Fury regeneration rate (Barbarian) — no DPS contribution in v1 (resource economy excluded).

Attr_Energy_Regen_Per_Second.notes: Energy regeneration rate (Rogue) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Essence_Regen_Per_Second.notes: Essence regeneration rate (Necromancer) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Mana_Cost_Reduction_Percent.notes: Mana Cost Reduction % (Sorcerer) — no direct DPS contribution in v1 (resource economy excluded).

Attr_Mana_On_Crit.notes: Mana restored on Critical Strike (Sorcerer) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Wrath_Regen_Per_Second.notes: Wrath regeneration rate (Paladin/Warlock) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Wrath_On_Kill.notes: Wrath on Kill (Paladin/Warlock) — no DPS contribution in v1 (resource economy excluded).

Attr_Dominance_Regen_Per_Second.notes: Dominance regeneration rate (Warlock secondary resource) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Ferocity_Regen_Per_Second.notes: Ferocity regeneration rate (Spiritborn) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Spirit_On_Kill.notes: Spirit on Kill (Druid/Spiritborn) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Max_Fury_Item.notes: Maximum Fury (Barbarian) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Max_Energy_Item.notes: Maximum Energy (Rogue) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Max_Essence_Item.notes: Maximum Essence (Necromancer) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Max_Wrath_Item.notes: Maximum Wrath (Paladin/Warlock) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Max_Spirit_Item.notes: Maximum Spirit (Druid/Spiritborn) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Life_Regeneration.notes: Life Regeneration (flat) — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Life_Regeneration_Percent.notes: Life Regeneration % — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Life_Steal_Percent.notes: Life Steal % — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Fortify_Generation_Percent.notes: Fortify Generation % — no DPS contribution in v1 (defensive mechanic).

Attr_Barrier_Generation_Percent.notes: Barrier Generation % — no DPS contribution in v1 (defensive mechanic).

Attr_Armor_Item_Percent.notes: Armor % bonus — no DPS contribution in v1.

Attr_Minion_Life_Percent.notes: Minion Life % bonus — no DPS contribution in v1 (survivability stat).

Attr_Crowd_Control_Duration_Percent.notes: Crowd Control Duration % — no direct DPS contribution in v1 (affects CC window, not raw damage).

Attr_Experience_Bonus_Percent.notes: Experience Bonus % — no DPS contribution (progression stat).

Attr_Gold_Find_Percent.notes: Gold Find % — no DPS contribution (economy stat).

Weapon_Damage_Min.notes: Weapon Damage Min implicit — base damage range handled directly by computeWeaponDamage; routed to non_damaging to satisfy bucket-coverage gate (D11).

buckets._comment: Defines the type and description for each bucket referenced in attributeToBucket.

additive.description: Additive damage bucket — all contributing values sum. Applied as (1 + sum).

crit_chance.description: Critical Strike Chance — summed across all items, hard-capped at 100%. Used as EV weight in critMult = 1 + CSC × CSD.

crit_damage.description: Critical Strike Damage — summed across all items, added to csBaseline. Used in EV formula.

attack_speed.description: Attack Speed — all additive AS affixes sum before breakpoint lookup (except Paladin/Warlock which use linear AS per D34).

vulnerable.description: Vulnerable damage — separate multiplicative bucket applied at vulnerableBaseline × uptime.

skill_specific_mult.description: Position B only: Skill-Specific damage as a distinct multiplicative bucket. Use via local override to flip Attr_Core_Skill_Damage_Percent from additive to this bucket.

cdr.description: Cooldown Reduction — hyperbolic formula: Effective CDR = CDR/(CDR+1.0). Reduces cooldown-gated skill cycle time.

primary_stat.description: Primary stat (Strength/Intelligence/Willpower/Dexterity). Each point adds primaryStatScalar to damage. Only the class's primary stat is counted.

non_damaging.description: Non-damaging stat — no DPS contribution in the engine.

constants._comment: Formula constants. All values verified against cited sources; patch-staleness flagged where known.
constants._csBaseline_notes: Base Critical Strike Damage: 50% bonus when critting. Source: maxroll_damage_s9. Widely verified; believed stable across seasons.
constants._vulnerableBaseline_notes: Vulnerable damage multiplier bonus: +20% (total ×1.20). Source: maxroll_damage_s9 (Season 9). PATCH-STALE WARNING: Season 13 changes unverified. Override via data/damage-config.local.json when confirmed. Decision D13.
constants._critBaseChance_notes: Base Critical Strike Chance before any affixes: 5%. Source: community_general. Stable across seasons.
constants._enemyDefenseMultiplier_notes: Enemy defense/armor/resistance reduction factor (placeholder 1.0 = no reduction for v1). TODO: populate with boss-level DR formula when datamine source confirmed. Source: not yet implemented.

breakpoints._comment: Attack speed breakpoint tables per class and weapon type. Source: maxroll_as_s11 (Season 11). Tables are approximate and may need updating for Season 13. Paladin and Warlock are OMITTED per D34 — those classes use linear AS without frame quantization. Each tier: { minMultiplier, framesPerAttack } where minMultiplier is the minimum (1 + total AS%) to reach this tier. 60 fps base rate. Effective APS = 60 / framesPerAttack.
breakpoints._paladin_warlock_note: Paladin and Warlock breakpoint tables intentionally omitted (D34). Their frame-timing mechanics are unverified in Season 13. The engine falls back to linear AS for these classes: effectiveAps = baseAps × asMult.

Barbarian._note: Barbarian has 4 weapon slots. Engine uses the highest-itemPower weapon. Breakpoints approximate from maxroll_as_s11.

Druid._note: Druid uses staff or 1h+offhand. Breakpoints approximate from maxroll_as_s11.

Necromancer._note: Necromancer uses scythes/swords/wands. Breakpoints approximate from maxroll_as_s11.

Rogue._note: Rogue uses daggers/bows/crossbows. Breakpoints approximate from maxroll_as_s11.

Sorcerer._note: Sorcerer uses staves/wands. Breakpoints approximate from maxroll_as_s11.

Spiritborn._note: Spiritborn uses polearms/staves. Breakpoints approximate from maxroll_as_s11.

drCoefficients._comment: Diminishing returns coefficients for non-linear stats.

cdr.notes: CDR formula (Position A, D14): Effective CDR = CDR_stat / (CDR_stat + 1.0). E.g. 50% CDR stat → 33.3% effective reduction; 100% → 50%. Position B (some sources): different parameters post-VoH. Verify for Season 13.

uptimes._comment: Default uptime weights per conditional type under boss-DPS framing.
uptimes._vulnerable_notes: 90% vulnerable uptime — middle of community 0.80–1.00 range (D10). Override to 1.0 for max-case or 0.0 to disable.
uptimes._elite_notes: 100% elite-damage uptime vs boss (boss is an elite). Elite-conditional affixes apply fully.
uptimes._cc_notes: 0% CC-conditional uptime vs boss. Bosses are immune to CC in D4 (D15). CC-conditional affixes contribute zero DPS.
uptimes._distance-close_notes: Placeholder — actual application determined by distanceDefault per class. Engine zeroes this if class is 'distant'.
uptimes._distance-distant_notes: Placeholder — actual application determined by distanceDefault per class. Engine zeroes this if class is 'close'.

distanceDefault._comment: Per-class distance-conditional default for boss-DPS framing (D12). 'close' = always in melee range; 'distant' = always at range. Override per character via local config.

_primaryStatScalar_notes: Damage bonus per primary stat point: +0.1% per point. Source: docs/data-sources/02-stats.md. Only the class's primary stat is counted (Barbarian/Paladin=Strength, Sorcerer/Necromancer/Warlock=Intelligence, Druid/Spiritborn=Willpower, Rogue=Dexterity). Base stat (from level) is not included in v1 — only item-granted stat is summed (D33).

classPrimaryStats._comment: Maps class name to its primary stat attribute name (D33). Used by engine to filter primary stat contributions.

weaponSlotsByClass._comment: Maps class name to the slot IDs to check for weapon items (in priority order). Engine uses the first equipped slot with an item.

weaponTypeBySlot._comment: Maps slot ID to 1h or 2h category for breakpoint table lookup. Barbarian slots are explicit; non-Barbarian 'weapon' defaults to '1h' for breakpoint purposes.

_baseWeaponAps_notes: Base weapon attacks-per-second — legacy fallback used when the equipped weapon type cannot be derived from the affix id. Weapon-type-specific APS comes from lib/catalog/game-math.json baseApsByWeaponType.
